# proxmox_storage_file_restore_list (Data Source)

Lists files in a file-restore snapshot from `/nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}/file-restore/list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_storage_file_restore_list" "l" {
  node    = "pve-1"
  storage = "backup"
  volume  = "backup:backup/vzdump-qemu-300-2026_01_01-00_00_00.vma.zst"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `storage` (String)

### Optional
